messages.author: Cario
messages.text: my happiness has been 3% since last night but i'm too dumb to figure out why. the tooltip says it should be increasing every tick based on my province & mandate

messages.author: Cario
messages.text: Update: now I should be losing 2 happiness per tick due to unemployment penalty. My happiness still hadn't changed tho

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1043204044774183032> hey, i looked at how happiness works: every hour your buildings add happiness, then unemployment takes off 10 if too many workers are jobless (it can look like less in the tooltip), and policies add/remove after that. if the building bonus is about the same as that penalty it just sits flat, which could be why it's stuck at 3%. can you tell me roughly what the tooltip lists for your province (the + and - numbers) and what your unemployment % is on the country page?

messages.author: Cario
messages.text: Fortunately/ unfortunately my happiness has started to adjust to the expected behavior and I cannot replicate this

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1043204044774183032> no worries, glad it sorted itself out. if it gets stuck again, tell me what the tooltip lists and i'll dig in

messages.author: Cheesar
messages.text: it seems to have happened again

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1043204044774183032> <@616524068987863060> found it, the game was counting part of your workforce as unemployed when they weren't, so you lost 10 happiness every hour and it kept snapping back to 3%. fixed now, Altoria already went 3 → 11 on this tick and should keep climbing like the tooltip says

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1043204044774183032> yep, same bug: workers with no education record were counted as unemployed (-10 happiness every hour). that's fixed and live, your happiness should climb normally now. shout if it sticks again

title: they say it'll make you happy. they lie
